  function setImage(id, bmp) {
    var v = S.images[id]; if (!v) return;
    onMain(function () { try { v.setImageBitmap(bmp); } catch (e) { err('设置图标 ' + id, e); } });
  }
  /* 改按钮文字（难度按钮要显示当前难度） */
  function setButton(id, text) {
    var v = S.views[id]; if (!v) return;
    onMain(function () { try { v.setText(jStr(text)); } catch (e) {} });
  }
  function setVisible(id, on) {
    var v = S.groups[id]; if (!v) return;
    onMain(function () { try { v.setVisibility(on ? 0 : 8); } catch (e) {} });
  }
  function setSwitch(id, on) {
    var v = S.switches[id]; if (!v) return;
    onMain(function () {
      try { S.suppress = true; v.setChecked(!!on); } catch (e) {} finally { S.suppress = false; }
    });
  }
  function setSeek(id, val) {
    var s = S.seeks[id]; if (!s) return;
    onMain(function () {
      try { s.bar.setProgress(Math.round(val) - s.min); } catch (e) {}
      try { s.label.setText(jStr(s.name + '：' + Math.round(val))); } catch (e) {}
    });
  }

  /* ── 找 Activity：优先 Unity 的静态字段，其次遍历 ActivityThread ── */
  function findActivity() {
    try {
      var UP = Java.use('com.unity3d.player.UnityPlayer');
      var a = UP.currentActivity.value;
      if (a) return a;
    } catch (e) { log('UnityPlayer.currentActivity 不可用：' + e); }
    try {
      var at = Java.use('android.app.ActivityThread').currentActivityThread();
      var it = at.mActivities.value.values().iterator();
      while (it.hasNext()) { var act = it.next().activity.value; if (act) return act; }
    } catch (e) { log('ActivityThread 兜底失败：' + e); }
    return null;
  }

  /* ── 清掉上一次运行遗留的面板；顺手把 content 容器返回给 close() 用 ── */
  function sweep(act) {
    try {
      /* findViewById 返回的包装类型是 android.view.View（Frida 只暴露声明返回类型的方法），
         要调 getChildCount/getChildAt 必须先 Java.cast 成 ViewGroup */
      var content = Java.cast(act.findViewById(Java.use('android.R$id').content.value), Java.use('android.view.ViewGroup'));
      if (!content) return null;
      for (var i = content.getChildCount() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var ch = content.getChildAt(i), cd = ch.getContentDescription();
        if (cd !== null && String(cd.toString()) === CFG.marker) { content.removeView(ch); log('已移除上一次残留的面板'); }
      }
      return content;
    } catch (e) { log('清理残留失败：' + e); return null; }
  }

  function close() {
    var p = S.root, wm = S.wm, mode = S.mode, par = S.parent;
    if (!p) { log('面板本来就没开'); return; }
    S.root = null; S.status = null; S.parent = null; S.closed = true;
    onMain(function () {
      try {
        closeOverlays();          // 面板关掉时弹层一起清掉，别留孤儿浮层
        /* 关面板优先用记下来的 content FrameLayout（ViewGroup 包装，removeView 一定在）。
           直接 p.getParent() 拿到的是 ViewParent 包装，实测调 removeView 报 not a function。 */
        if (mode === 'panel' && wm) wm.removeView(p);
        else if (par) par.removeView(p);
        else { var g = p.getParent(); if (g) g.removeView(p); }
        log('面板已关闭（il2cpp 钩子仍在，要彻底停用请 jshook.py unload）');
      } catch (e) { err('关闭面板', e); }
    });
  }

  /* ── 建界面（必须在主线程） ── */
  function build(act, spec, dispatch) {
    try {
      var contentParent = sweep(act);
      /* 必须包一层：写 `var juse = Java.use` 会把方法摘出来导致 this 丢失，
         Java.use 内部读 this.classFactory 时会报「cannot read property 'classFactory' of undefined」 */
      function juse(n) { return Java.use(n); }
      var dm = act.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
      var dens = dm.density.value, shortDp = Math.min(dm.widthPixels.value, dm.heightPixels.value) / dens;
      function dp(v) { return Math.round(v * dens); }

      var WRAP = -2, MATCH = -1, VISIBLE = 0, GONE = 8;
      var LinearLayout = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout'), TextView = juse('android.widget.TextView'),
          Button = juse('android.widget.Button'), ScrollView = juse('android.widget.ScrollView'),
          SeekBar = juse('android.widget.SeekBar'),
          ImageView = juse('android.widget.ImageView'), IVScale = juse('android.widget.ImageView$ScaleType'),
          FLP = juse('android.widget.FrameLayout$LayoutParams'), LLP = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout$LayoutParams'),
          GD = juse('android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable'), Gravity = juse('android.view.Gravity');
      var ClickI = juse('android.view.View$OnClickListener'), TouchI = juse('android.view.View$OnTouchListener'),
          CheckI = juse('android.widget.CompoundButton$OnCheckedChangeListener'),
          SeekI = juse('android.widget.SeekBar$OnSeekBarChangeListener');
      var SwitchCls = null;
      try { SwitchCls = juse('android.widget.Switch'); } catch (e) { SwitchCls = juse('android.widget.ToggleButton'); }

      function flat(color) { var d = GD.$new(); d.setColor(color); d.setCornerRadius(dp(6)); return d; }
      function flatOn(color) { var d = flat(color); try { d.setStroke(dp(1), C.title); } catch (e) {} return d; }
      function compact(v) {
        try { v.setAllCaps(false); } catch (e) {}
        try { v.setMinHeight(0); v.setMinimumHeight(0); v.setMinWidth(0); v.setMinimumWidth(0); } catch (e) {}
        v.setPadding(dp(8), dp(5), dp(8), dp(5));
      }
      /* ═════ 监听器：每类只注册「一个」动态类，用 View 的 tag 分发 ═════
         每个 Java.registerClass 都会新建一个 DexClassLoader；ART 编「类加载器上下文」是递归的
         （ClassLoaderContext::EncodeContextInternal ↔ EncodeSharedLibAndParent），
         动态类注册多了会递归过深 → 栈溢出 SIGSEGV（2026-09-19 把游戏打崩过一次，512 帧全是这两函数）。
         所以整个会话里 click / check / seek / touch 各只有**一个类实例**，靠 tag 找到处理函数。 */
      var HANDLERS = {}, HSEQ = 0, CLICKER = null;
      function bindClick(v, target) {
        var name;
        if (typeof target === 'function') { name = 'h' + (++HSEQ); HANDLERS[name] = target; }
        else { name = String(target); }
        if (!CLICKER) {
          CLICKER = Java.registerClass({ name: uniq('Clk'), implements: [ClickI],
            methods: { onClick: function (view) {
              var t = ''; try { t = String(view.getTag().toString()); } catch (e) {}
              if (!t) return;
              if (HANDLERS[t]) { try { HANDLERS[t](view); } catch (e) { err('点击处理 ' + t, e); } return; }
              try { dispatch(t); } catch (e) { err('点击 ' + t, e); }
            } } }).$new();
        }
        try { v.setTag(jStr(name)); } catch (e) {}
        v.setOnClickListener(CLICKER);
        S.views[name] = v;                 // 便于自检/调试直接 performClick
        return v;
      }
      var CHECKER = null;
      function bindCheck(v, id) {
        if (!CHECKER) {
          CHECKER = Java.registerClass({ name: uniq('Chk'), implements: [CheckI],
            methods: { onCheckedChanged: function (btn, checked) {
              if (S.suppress) return;                     // setSwitch() 的程序化赋值不要回调
              var t = ''; try { t = String(btn.getTag().toString()); } catch (e) {}
              if (!t) return;
              try { dispatch(t, checked); } catch (e) { err('开关 ' + t, e); }
            } } }).$new();
        }
        try { v.setTag(jStr(String(id))); } catch (e) {}
        v.setOnCheckedChangeListener(CHECKER);
        return v;
      }
      /* 开关工厂：twoCol=true 时字小一点、最多两行，适配两列排布 */
      function makeSwitch(it, twoCol) {
        var s = SwitchCls.$new(act);
        s.setText(jStr(it.label)); s.setTextSize(twoCol ? 10 : 11); s.setTextColor(C.text);
        s.setChecked(!!it.val);
        try { s.setMaxLines(2); } catch (e) {}
        compact(s);
        bindCheck(s, it.id);
        if (it.id) S.switches[it.id] = s;
        return s;
      }
      /* 自适应高度：把当前页量一遍，滚动区高度 = min(内容高, 上限)，短页不留一大片空 */
      var listMaxPx = dp(Math.max(170, Math.round(shortDp * 0.54)));   // 滚动区高度上限
      function fitScroll() {
        try {
          var VS = juse('android.view.View$MeasureSpec');
          content.measure(VS.makeMeasureSpec(dp(CFG.widthDp) - dp(18), -2147483648 /*AT_MOST*/),
                          VS.makeMeasureSpec(0, 0 /*UNSPECIFIED*/));
          var h = content.getMeasuredHeight();
          if (!(h > 0)) h = listMaxPx;
          scroll.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, Math.min(h + dp(6), listMaxPx)));
        } catch (e) { err('自适应高度', e); }
      }
      var SEEKER = null, SEEK_MIN = {};
      function bindSeek(v, id, min) {
        if (!SEEKER) {
          SEEKER = Java.registerClass({ name: uniq('Sk'), implements: [SeekI],
            methods: {
              onProgressChanged: function (bar, prog, fromUser) {
                if (!fromUser) return;                    // setSeek() 的程序化赋值不要回调
                var t = ''; try { t = String(bar.getTag().toString()); } catch (e) {}
                if (!t) return;
                try { dispatch(t, (SEEK_MIN[t] || 0) + prog); } catch (e) { err('滑块 ' + t, e); }
              },
              /* 拖动期间不要被「跟随游戏时间」覆盖 */
              onStartTrackingTouch: function (bar) { S.seekDragging = true; },
              onStopTrackingTouch: function (bar) { S.seekDragging = false; }
            } }).$new();
        }
        SEEK_MIN[String(id)] = min || 0;
        try { v.setTag(jStr(String(id))); } catch (e) {}
        v.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(SEEKER);
        return v;
      }

      /* 面板根 */
      var panel = LinearLayout.$new(act);
      panel.setOrientation(1);
      panel.setContentDescription(jStr(CFG.marker));      // ← 供 sweep() 识别
      var pbg = GD.$new(); pbg.setColor(C.panel); pbg.setCornerRadius(dp(12)); pbg.setStroke(dp(1), C.line);
      panel.setBackground(pbg);
      panel.setPadding(dp(8), dp(6), dp(8), dp(8));

      /* 标题栏（拖动把手 + 收起）。按用户要求**不放关闭按钮**：
         面板属于游戏进程，退出游戏它自然就没了，不需要手动关。 */
      var bar = LinearLayout.$new(act); bar.setOrientation(0); bar.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL.value);
      var title = TextView.$new(act);
      title.setText(jStr('≡ ' + CFG.title)); title.setTextSize(14); title.setTextColor(C.title);
      title.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0));
      var fold = Button.$new(act);
      fold.setText(jStr('▾')); fold.setTextSize(12); fold.setTextColor(C.sub); compact(fold);
      fold.setBackground(flat(C.btn)); fold.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(WRAP, WRAP));
      /* 不用 setOnClickListener：收起后它是屏幕上唯一的控件，必须同时支持拖动，
         所以交给下面的 dragTap 统一处理「轻点=收起/展开，拖=移动面板」。 */
      bar.addView(title); bar.addView(fold);
      panel.addView(bar);

      /* 状态栏 */
      var status = TextView.$new(act);
      status.setText(jStr('就绪（点下面按钮）')); status.setTextSize(11); status.setTextColor(C.sub);
      status.setPadding(dp(4), dp(2), dp(4), dp(4));
      panel.addView(status);

      /* ── 顶部标签页 ──
         按 SPEC 里的 page 节点自动生成一排等宽标签，点一下切换显示哪一页。
         比「手风琴全放在一条滚动里」省得多：一屏就放得下，基本不用滚。 */
      var tabBar = LinearLayout.$new(act); tabBar.setOrientation(0);
      tabBar.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
      var tabBtns = {};
      function paintTabs() {
        for (var id in tabBtns) {
          var on = (S.activePage === id);
          try { tabBtns[id].setTextColor(on ? C.title : C.sub); } catch (e) {}
          try { tabBtns[id].setBackground(on ? flatOn(C.btn) : flat(C.btn)); } catch (e) {}
        }
      }
      function showPage(id) {
        if (!S.pages[id]) return;
        S.activePage = id;
        for (var k in S.pages) { try { S.pages[k].setVisibility(k === id ? VISIBLE : GONE); } catch (e) {} }
        paintTabs();
        onMain(function () {
          try { UI.bagClosePopup(); } catch (e) {}
          fitScroll();
          /* 进页时自动做一次「读当前状态」：角色→读属性、武器→读武器、时间→同步时间条 */
          try { if (typeof onPageEnter === 'function') onPageEnter(id); } catch (e) { err('进页钩子', e); }
        });
      }
      S.showPage = showPage;      // 暴露给模块级导出（自检/调试要切页）
      var pageDefs = [];
      for (var pd0 = 0; pd0 < spec.length; pd0++) if (spec[pd0].k === 'page') pageDefs.push(spec[pd0]);
      for (var pi = 0; pi < pageDefs.length; pi++) {
        (function (pd, first) {
          var tb = Button.$new(act);
          tb.setText(jStr(pd.label)); tb.setTextSize(11); tb.setTextColor(C.sub);
          compact(tb); tb.setBackground(flat(C.btn));
          var tlp = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0); if (!first) tlp.leftMargin.value = dp(2);
          tb.setLayoutParams(tlp);
          bindClick(tb, function () { try { showPage(pd.id); } catch (e) { err('切标签', e); } });
          tabBtns[pd.id] = tb;
          tabBar.addView(tb);
        })(pageDefs[pi], pi === 0);
      }
      if (pageDefs.length) panel.addView(tabBar);

      /* 滚动区 */
      var content = LinearLayout.$new(act); content.setOrientation(1);
      var scroll = ScrollView.$new(act);
      scroll.addView(content);
      scroll.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, dp(Math.max(150, Math.round(shortDp * CFG.heightRatio)))));
      panel.addView(scroll);

      /* ── 递归建控件 ──
         head  折叠分组 · group 可被代码控制显隐的容器（自适应武器选项靠它）
         row   一排等宽按钮 · seek 滑块+数值 · text 可动态改字的标签
         btn / sw / note 普通按钮 / 开关 / 说明 */
      function buildInto(parent, items) {
        var cur = parent;
        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
          var it = items[i];
          var clp = LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP); clp.bottomMargin.value = dp(3);

          /* page：一整页（由顶部标签切换显隐），内部照常递归建控件 */
          if (it.k === 'page') {
            var pg = LinearLayout.$new(act); pg.setOrientation(1); pg.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
            pg.setVisibility(GONE);
            S.pages[it.id] = pg;
            cur.addView(pg);
            buildInto(pg, it.items || []);
            continue;
          }
          if (it.k === 'head') {
            var head = Button.$new(act);
            head.setText(jStr((it.open ? '▼ ' : '▶ ') + it.text));
            head.setTextSize(13); head.setTextColor(C.title);
            head.setGravity(Gravity.START.value | Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL.value);
            compact(head); head.setBackground(flat(C.btn));
            var hlp = LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP); hlp.topMargin.value = dp(6); hlp.bottomMargin.value = dp(3);
            head.setLayoutParams(hlp);
            var body = LinearLayout.$new(act); body.setOrientation(1); body.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
            body.setVisibility(it.open ? VISIBLE : GONE);
            bindClick(head, function () {
              try {
                var show = body.getVisibility() !== VISIBLE;
                body.setVisibility(show ? VISIBLE : GONE);
                head.setText(jStr((show ? '▼ ' : '▶ ') + it.text));
              } catch (e) { err('折叠组', e); }
            });
            /* 必须加到 parent，不能加到 cur —— cur 在上一个 head 处理后已经指向「上一个分组的 body」了，
               若加到 cur，后面所有分组都会被塞进第一个分组里（折叠它就全没了）。 */
            parent.addView(head); parent.addView(body);
            cur = body;
            continue;
          }
          if (it.k === 'group') {
            var g = LinearLayout.$new(act); g.setOrientation(1); g.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
            g.setVisibility(it.open ? VISIBLE : GONE);
            cur.addView(g);
            S.groups[it.id] = g;
            buildInto(g, it.items || []);
            continue;
          }
          if (it.k === 'row') {
            var r = LinearLayout.$new(act); r.setOrientation(0); r.setLayoutParams(clp);
            for (var j = 0; j < it.items.length; j++) {
              var bi = it.items[j];
              var rb = Button.$new(act);
              rb.setText(jStr(bi.label)); rb.setTextSize(11); rb.setTextColor(C.text);
              compact(rb); rb.setBackground(flat(C.btn));
              var blp = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0);
              if (j) blp.leftMargin.value = dp(3);
              rb.setLayoutParams(blp);
              bindClick(rb, bi.id);
              r.addView(rb);
            }
            cur.addView(r);
            continue;
          }
          if (it.k === 'seek') {
            var box = LinearLayout.$new(act); box.setOrientation(1); box.setLayoutParams(clp);
            var sl = TextView.$new(act);
            sl.setText(jStr((it.label || '') + '：' + (it.val !== undefined ? it.val : it.min)));
            sl.setTextSize(11); sl.setTextColor(C.sub);
            sl.setPadding(dp(2), dp(1), dp(2), dp(1));
            var sb = SeekBar.$new(act);
            sb.setMax(it.max - it.min);
            sb.setProgress((it.val !== undefined ? it.val : it.min) - it.min);
            bindSeek(sb, it.id, it.min);
            box.addView(sl); box.addView(sb);
            cur.addView(box);
            S.seeks[it.id] = { bar: sb, label: sl, min: it.min, name: it.label || it.id };
            continue;
          }
          if (it.k === 'text') {
            var tv = TextView.$new(act);
            tv.setText(jStr(it.text || '')); tv.setTextSize(11); tv.setTextColor(C.text);
            tv.setPadding(dp(4), dp(3), dp(4), dp(3)); tv.setLayoutParams(clp);
            cur.addView(tv);
            if (it.id) S.labels[it.id] = tv;
            continue;
          }
          /* 图标 + 文字一行：同一个 id 同时注册到 S.images（setImage）与 S.labels（setLabel）。
             图标拿不到时 ImageView 就是空的，文字照常显示。 */
          if (it.k === 'iconrow') {
            var ir = LinearLayout.$new(act); ir.setOrientation(0);
            ir.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL.value); ir.setLayoutParams(clp);
            var iv = ImageView.$new(act);
            var icz = dp(it.size || 44);
            iv.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(icz, icz));
            iv.setScaleType(IVScale.FIT_CENTER.value);
            if (!it.click) iv.setBackground(flat(C.btn));      // 整行可点时背景放整行上，图标不重复画底
            iv.setPadding(dp(2), dp(2), dp(2), dp(2));
            ir.addView(iv);
            var tv2 = TextView.$new(act);
            tv2.setText(jStr(it.text || '')); tv2.setTextSize(11); tv2.setTextColor(C.text);
            tv2.setPadding(dp(6), dp(3), dp(4), dp(3));
            tv2.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0));
            ir.addView(tv2);
            if (it.click) {                                   // 整行可点（例：点物品图标直接弹选择面板）
              ir.setBackground(flat(C.btn));
              ir.setPadding(dp(2), dp(2), dp(2), dp(2));
              bindClick(ir, it.click);
            }
            cur.addView(ir);
            if (it.id) { S.images[it.id] = iv; S.labels[it.id] = tv2; }
            continue;
          }
          /* 文字 + 行尾小按钮（一行搞定，不占一整行按钮）：例「伤害增量：50  [改]」 */
          if (it.k === 'labelbtn') {
            var lr = LinearLayout.$new(act); lr.setOrientation(0);
            lr.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL.value); lr.setLayoutParams(clp);
            var lt = TextView.$new(act);
            lt.setText(jStr(it.text || '')); lt.setTextSize(11); lt.setTextColor(C.text);
            lt.setPadding(dp(4), dp(3), dp(4), dp(3));
            lt.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0));
            lr.addView(lt);
            var lb = Button.$new(act);
            lb.setText(jStr(it.btnLabel || '改')); lb.setTextSize(11); lb.setTextColor(C.sub);
            compact(lb); lb.setBackground(flat(C.btn));
            lb.setPadding(dp(10), dp(4), dp(10), dp(4));
            lb.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(WRAP, WRAP));
            bindClick(lb, it.btnId);
            lr.addView(lb);
            cur.addView(lr);
            if (it.id) S.labels[it.id] = lt;
            continue;
          }
          if (it.k === 'btn') {
            var b = Button.$new(act);
            b.setText(jStr(it.label)); b.setTextSize(12); b.setTextColor(C.text);
            b.setGravity(Gravity.START.value | Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL.value);
            compact(b); b.setBackground(flat(C.btn)); b.setLayoutParams(clp);
            bindClick(b, it.id);
            cur.addView(b);
            continue;
          }
          if (it.k === 'sw') {
            /* 连续两个「短标签」开关并排成一行（两列），高度直接省一半。
               标签长的（wide:true）或落单的仍占整行，否则字会挤成两行看不清。 */
            var nxt = items[i + 1];
            if (!it.wide && nxt && nxt.k === 'sw' && !nxt.wide) {
              var srow = LinearLayout.$new(act); srow.setOrientation(0); srow.setLayoutParams(clp);
              var s1 = makeSwitch(it);
              var l1 = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0);
              s1.setLayoutParams(l1); srow.addView(s1);
              var s2 = makeSwitch(nxt);
              var l2 = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0); l2.leftMargin.value = dp(3);
              s2.setLayoutParams(l2); srow.addView(s2);
              cur.addView(srow);
              i++;
              continue;
            }
            cur.addView(makeSwitch(it, true));
            continue;
          }
          if (it.k === 'note') {
            var nt = TextView.$new(act);
            nt.setText(jStr(it.text)); nt.setTextSize(11); nt.setTextColor(C.sub);
            nt.setPadding(dp(4), dp(2), dp(4), dp(4)); nt.setLayoutParams(clp);
            cur.addView(nt);
            continue;
          }
        }
      }
      buildInto(content, spec);
      if (S.activePage && S.pages[S.activePage]) {          // 重发脚本时保留上次停在的那一页
        showPage(S.activePage);
      } else if (pageDefs.length) {
        showPage((pageDefs.filter(function (d) { return d.open; })[0] || pageDefs[0]).id);
      } else { onMain(function () { fitScroll(); }); }

      /* 收起 / 展开：只留标题栏那颗按钮，其余全部 GONE，并把根视图宽度改成 WRAP_CONTENT，
         这样收起来就是贴着原位的一小块 chip。轻点再还原。 */
      var collapsed = false;
      function setCollapsed(on) {
        collapsed = !!on;
        status.setVisibility(collapsed ? GONE : VISIBLE);
        scroll.setVisibility(collapsed ? GONE : VISIBLE);
        title.setVisibility(collapsed ? GONE : VISIBLE);
        try { tabBar.setVisibility(collapsed ? GONE : VISIBLE); } catch (e) {}   // 收起时标签栏也要藏起来，不然 chip 上会留一排标签
        fold.setText(jStr(collapsed ? '≡ 修改器' : '▾'));
        try {
          var plp = panel.getLayoutParams();
          if (plp) { plp.width.value = collapsed ? WRAP : dp(CFG.widthDp); panel.setLayoutParams(plp); }
        } catch (e) { err('收起时改宽度', e); }
        S.collapsed = collapsed;
      }
      S.setCollapsed = setCollapsed;

      /* 触摸兜底：面板自己消费掉没被控件处理的触摸，避免漏给下层游戏 */
      panel.setOnTouchListener(swallowListener());

      /* 拖动 / 轻点：一套手势同时服务「展开时拖标题栏」和「收起后拖小 chip」。
         注意 Button 自己会消费触摸 → 挂在父容器上的监听器收不到落在按钮上的手势，
         所以 fold 必须自带监听器，并由它自己区分拖动与点击。 */
      var SLOP = dp(8);
      function movePanel(nx, ny) {
        if (S.mode === 'panel' && S.lp) { S.lp.x.value = Math.round(nx); S.lp.y.value = Math.round(ny); S.wm.updateViewLayout(panel, S.lp); }
        else { panel.setX(nx); panel.setY(ny); }
      }
      /* 拖动/轻点：同样只注册一个类，每个目标的状态（按下点、是否已移动、轻点回调）记在 DRAGS 里 */
      var DRAG = null, DRAGS = {};
      function bindDrag(v, key, onTap) {
        if (!DRAG) {
          DRAG = Java.registerClass({ name: uniq('DT'), implements: [TouchI],
            methods: { onTouch: function (view, ev) {
              var k = ''; try { k = String(view.getTag().toString()); } catch (e) {}
              var d = DRAGS[k];
              if (!d) return true;
              try {
                var a = ev.getAction();
                if (a === 0) {
                  d.dx = ev.getRawX() - panel.getX(); d.dy = ev.getRawY() - panel.getY();
                  d.x0 = ev.getRawX(); d.y0 = ev.getRawY(); d.moved = false;
                } else if (a === 2) {
                  if (!d.moved && (Math.abs(ev.getRawX() - d.x0) > SLOP || Math.abs(ev.getRawY() - d.y0) > SLOP)) d.moved = true;
                  if (d.moved) movePanel(ev.getRawX() - d.dx, ev.getRawY() - d.dy);
                } else if (a === 1 || a === 3) {
                  if (!d.moved && d.onTap) { try { d.onTap(); } catch (e) { err('轻点', e); } }
                }
              } catch (e) { err('拖动/轻点', e); }
              return true;
            } } }).$new();
        }
        DRAGS[key] = { onTap: onTap, dx: 0, dy: 0, x0: 0, y0: 0, moved: false };
        try { v.setTag(jStr(key)); } catch (e) {}
        v.setOnTouchListener(DRAG);
      }
      bindDrag(bar, 'drag-bar', null);
      bindDrag(fold, 'drag-fold', function () { dispatch('__collapse'); });

      /* 挂进游戏窗口 */
      if (CFG.host === 'panel') {
        var WLP = juse('android.view.WindowManager$LayoutParams');
        var lp = WLP.$new(dp(CFG.widthDp), WRAP, 1000 /*TYPE_APPLICATION_PANEL*/, 0x00000200 | 0x00040000 /*NOT_FOCUSABLE|NOT_TOUCH_MODAL*/, -3 /*TRANSLUCENT*/);
        lp.gravity.value = Gravity.TOP.value | Gravity.START.value;
        lp.x.value = dp(CFG.startXDp); lp.y.value = dp(CFG.startYDp);
        S.wm = act.getWindowManager(); S.wm.addView(panel, lp); S.lp = lp; S.mode = 'panel';
      } else {
        var flp = FLP.$new(dp(CFG.widthDp), WRAP);
        flp.gravity.value = Gravity.TOP.value | Gravity.START.value;
        flp.leftMargin.value = dp(CFG.startXDp); flp.topMargin.value = dp(CFG.startYDp);
        act.addContentView(panel, flp); S.mode = 'content';
      }
      S.act = act; S.root = panel; S.status = status; S.parent = contentParent; S.closed = false;
      S.dispatch = dispatch;                     // 背包弹窗等模块级代码用
      /* 弹层（分类选物品 / 数字键盘）复用这套构建上下文 */
      S.ctx = { act: act, juse: juse, dp: dp, flat: flat, flatOn: flatOn, compact: compact, bindClick: bindClick,
                widthPx: dp(CFG.widthDp), listPx: dp(Math.max(170, Math.round(shortDp * 0.54))),
                posX: function () { return panel.getX(); }, posY: function () { return panel.getY(); } };
      log('面板已挂载（' + S.mode + '，宽 ' + CFG.widthDp + 'dp，顶层节点 ' + spec.length + ' 个）');
      say('就绪：面板已挂载，触摸不会穿透');
    } catch (e) { err('建界面', e); }
  }

  /* ═════════ 弹层：分类选物品 + 数字键盘 ═════════
     都是挂在同一个窗口里的浮层（addContentView 后加的在上层），触摸由自己消费。
     **不弹系统输入法**：游戏窗口里 IME 行为不可靠，数字改成面板内置键盘输入。 */
  function overlay(titleText) {
    var K = S.ctx;
    if (!K) { log('面板未就绪，弹层不可用'); return null; }
    var juse = K.juse, act = K.act, dp = K.dp, WRAP = -2, MATCH = -1;
    var LL = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout'), TV = juse('android.widget.TextView'),
        BT = juse('android.widget.Button'), SV = juse('android.widget.ScrollView'),
        FLP = juse('android.widget.FrameLayout$LayoutParams'), LLP = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout$LayoutParams'),
        GD = juse('android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable'), GR = juse('android.view.Gravity'),
        TouchI = juse('android.view.View$OnTouchListener');
    var root = LL.$new(act); root.setOrientation(1);
    root.setContentDescription(jStr(CFG.marker));            // 让 sweep() 也能清掉弹层
    var bg = GD.$new(); bg.setColor(argb(0xF2, 0x0E, 0x12, 0x18)); bg.setCornerRadius(dp(12)); bg.setStroke(dp(1), C.line);
    root.setBackground(bg); root.setPadding(dp(8), dp(6), dp(8), dp(8));
    var bar = LL.$new(act); bar.setOrientation(0); bar.setGravity(GR.CENTER_VERTICAL.value);
    var ttl = TV.$new(act); ttl.setText(jStr('☰ ' + titleText)); ttl.setTextSize(14); ttl.setTextColor(C.title);
    ttl.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0));
    var x = BT.$new(act); x.setText(jStr('✕ 关闭')); x.setTextSize(12); x.setTextColor(C.warn);
    K.compact(x); x.setBackground(K.flat(C.btn)); x.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(WRAP, WRAP));
    bar.addView(ttl); bar.addView(x); root.addView(bar);
    var body = LL.$new(act); body.setOrientation(1);
    var scroll = SV.$new(act); scroll.addView(body);
    scroll.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, K.listPx));
    root.addView(scroll);
    root.setOnTouchListener(swallowListener());
    /* 自适应高度：内容量一遍，滚动区高度 = min(内容高, 可用高度)。
       这样数字键盘/物品列表都不会被窗口底边裁掉（之前「有些按钮被挡住」就是这个原因）。 */
    function fit(heightCap) {
      try {
        var VS = juse('android.view.View$MeasureSpec');
        body.measure(VS.makeMeasureSpec(K.widthPx - dp(18), -2147483648 /*AT_MOST*/),
                     VS.makeMeasureSpec(0, 0 /*UNSPECIFIED*/));
        var h = body.getMeasuredHeight();
        var scr = act.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels.value;
        var avail = Math.max(dp(140), Math.round(scr - K.posY() - dp(90)));
        var cap = heightCap || avail;
        scroll.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, Math.min(Math.max(h + dp(10), dp(120)), Math.min(cap, avail))));
      } catch (e) { err('弹层自适应高度', e); }
    }
    function close() {
      try {
        /* 和面板的 close() 一样：必须用记下来的 content FrameLayout（ViewGroup 包装）移除，
           root.getParent() 返回的是 ViewParent 包装，实测调 removeView 报 not a function → 弹层关不掉 */
        var par = S.parent;
        if (par) par.removeView(root);
        else { var g = root.getParent(); if (g) g.removeView(root); }
        var k = OVL.indexOf(close); if (k >= 0) OVL.splice(k, 1);
        log('弹层已关闭：' + titleText);
      } catch (e) { err('关弹层', e); }
    }
    /* 同屏只留一个弹层：新弹层打开前把旧的都关掉，
       否则反复点「选择物品」会一层层叠起来（上层挡住下层、关的时候也容易留残影）。 */
    closeOverlays();
    OVL.push(close);
    K.bindClick(x, close);
    var flp = FLP.$new(K.widthPx, WRAP);
    flp.gravity.value = GR.TOP.value | GR.START.value;
    flp.leftMargin.value = Math.round(K.posX()); flp.topMargin.value = Math.round(K.posY());
    act.addContentView(root, flp);
    log('弹层已打开：' + titleText);
    return { root: root, body: body, title: ttl, close: close, scroll: scroll, fit: fit };
  }

  /* 数字键盘：标题 / 初值 / 回调（避免在游戏窗口里弹 IME） */
  function promptNumber(title, initial, onOk) {
    var K = S.ctx; if (!K) return;
    var o = overlay(title); if (!o) return;
    var juse = K.juse, act = K.act, dp = K.dp, WRAP = -2, MATCH = -1;
    var LL = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout'), TV = juse('android.widget.TextView'),
        BT = juse('android.widget.Button'), LLP = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout$LayoutParams'), GR = juse('android.view.Gravity');
    var buf = String(initial === undefined || initial === null ? '' : initial);
    var show = TV.$new(act); show.setTextSize(22); show.setTextColor(C.text);
    show.setGravity(GR.CENTER.value); show.setPadding(dp(6), dp(6), dp(6), dp(10));
    function refresh() { show.setText(jStr(buf === '' ? '（点下面的数字）' : buf)); }
    refresh(); o.body.addView(show);
    function mk(label, fn, big) {
      var b = BT.$new(act); b.setText(jStr(label)); b.setTextSize(big ? 17 : 13); b.setTextColor(C.text);
      K.compact(b); b.setBackground(K.flat(C.btn)); K.bindClick(b, fn);
      return b;
    }
    var pad = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '清空', '0', '⌫'];
    for (var r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
      var row = LL.$new(act); row.setOrientation(0); row.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
      for (var c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
        var label = pad[r * 3 + c];
        var b = mk(label, (function (L) {
          return function () {
            if (L === '清空') buf = '';
            else if (L === '⌫') buf = buf.slice(0, -1);
            else if (buf.length < 9) buf += L;
            refresh();
          };
        })(label), true);
        var lp = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0); if (c) lp.leftMargin.value = dp(3);
        b.setLayoutParams(lp); row.addView(b);
      }
      o.body.addView(row);
    }
    var okRow = LL.$new(act); okRow.setOrientation(0); okRow.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
    var ok = mk('确定', function () { var v = parseInt(buf, 10); if (isNaN(v)) v = 0; onOk(v); o.close(); });
    var cancel = mk('取消', function () { o.close(); });
    var l1 = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0), l2 = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0); l2.leftMargin.value = dp(3);
    ok.setLayoutParams(l1); cancel.setLayoutParams(l2);
    okRow.addView(ok); okRow.addView(cancel);
    o.body.addView(okRow);
    try { o.fit(); } catch (e) {}          // 键盘整块按内容给高度，别让下面几排被裁掉
  }

  /* 分类选物品：类别页 → 物品页（分页，每页 40 件）→ 点选回调 */
  function pickItem(onPick, startCat) {
    var K = S.ctx; if (!K) return;
    var o = overlay('选择物品'); if (!o) return;
    try { ICON.warm(); } catch (e) {}
    var juse = K.juse, act = K.act, dp = K.dp, WRAP = -2, MATCH = -1, VIS = 0, GONE = 8;
    var LL = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout'), BT = juse('android.widget.Button'),
        TV = juse('android.widget.TextView'), LLP = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout$LayoutParams'),
        GR = juse('android.view.Gravity');
    var COLS = 4;                                   // 每行 4 个格子
    var IV = juse('android.widget.ImageView'), IVS = juse('android.widget.ImageView$ScaleType');
    var ICON_PX = dp(44);
    var ROW_H = dp(64);                             // 行高固定：虚拟列表定位靠它
    var VIS_ROWS = 6;                               // 窗口行数
    var TILE_BG = K.flat(C.btn);

    /* ═════ 物品选择器 ═════
       布局（都在同一个浮层里，从上到下）：
         [标题栏] [搜索框 + 清空] [横向滚动的分类 chips] [件数] [虚拟列表]
       分类改成横向一排，点完直接在下面出列表（不再跳转到类别页）；
       搜索用系统输入法（EditText），按名字过滤（用离线名表，零 il2cpp 调用）。 */
    var curCat = -1, curQuery = '', curIds = [], nameCache = {};
    /* 上限取「运行时物品数」与「离线名表长度」的较大者：
       游戏更新加了新物品时，新 ID 照样能列出（名字用运行时兜底，图标没有就显示 ID 占位）。 */
    var ITEM_MAX = Math.max(NAMES.count, (function () { try { return IL.itemCount() | 0; } catch (e) { return 0; } })());
    log('物品范围上限 = ' + ITEM_MAX + '（离线名表 ' + NAMES.count + '）');
    var rows = [], curFirst = -1, topPad = null, botPad = null, win = null;
    var searchEt = null, infoTv = null, chipBtns = {}, chipRow = null, SCROLLER = null, WATCHER = null;
    var catCache = {};

    function clear() { o.body.removeAllViews(); topPad = botPad = null; rows = []; }
    function catIds(k) {                            // 分类 → id 列表（缓存）
      if (catCache[k]) return catCache[k];
      var out = (k < 0) ? null : idsOfCat(k);
      catCache[k] = out;
      return out;
    }
    function nameJava(id) {
      var c = nameCache[id];
      if (c !== undefined) return c;
      var nm = ''; try { nm = itemNameFast(id); } catch (e) {}
      if (nm.length > 6) nm = nm.slice(0, 6) + '…';
      var str = jStr(nm || ('#' + id));
      nameCache[id] = str;
      return str;
    }
    /* 按「分类 + 搜索词」算出当前要显示的 id 列表 */
    function computeIds() {
      var q = (curQuery || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q) {
        var c = catIds(curCat);
        if (c) return c;
        var all = [];
        for (var i = 1; i <= ITEM_MAX; i++) if (ICON.rect(i) || NAMES.get(i)) all.push(i);   // 全部：有图标或有名字的
        return all;
      }
      var base = catIds(curCat), set = null;
      if (base) { set = {}; for (var b = 0; b < base.length; b++) set[base[b]] = 1; }
      var out2 = [];
      for (var id = 1; id < ITEM_MAX; id++) {
        if (set && !set[id]) continue;
        var nm = NAMES.get(id);
        if (!nm) { try { nm = itemNameFast(id); } catch (e) {} }   // 名表没有 → 问游戏（新物品）
        if (!nm) continue;
        if (nm.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0) out2.push(id);
      }
      return out2;
    }
    function makeTile() {
      var t = {};
      var cell = LL.$new(act); cell.setOrientation(1); cell.setGravity(GR.CENTER_HORIZONTAL.value);
      var lp = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0);
      lp.leftMargin.value = dp(2); lp.rightMargin.value = dp(2);
      cell.setLayoutParams(lp); cell.setBackground(TILE_BG);
      cell.setPadding(dp(2), dp(1), dp(2), dp(1));
      var iv = IV.$new(act); iv.setScaleType(IVS.FIT_CENTER.value);
      iv.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, ICON_PX));
      cell.addView(iv);
      var ph = TV.$new(act); ph.setTextSize(9); ph.setTextColor(C.sub);
      ph.setGravity(GR.CENTER.value); ph.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, ICON_PX));
      ph.setVisibility(GONE);
      cell.addView(ph);
      var tv = TV.$new(act); tv.setTextSize(9); tv.setTextColor(C.text);
      tv.setGravity(GR.CENTER.value); tv.setMaxLines(1); tv.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
      cell.addView(tv);
      t.cell = cell; t.iv = iv; t.ph = ph; t.tv = tv; t.id = -1;
      K.bindClick(cell, function () { if (t.id > 0) { pick(t.id); } });
      return t;
    }
    function pick(id) {
      try { hideIme(); } catch (e) {}
      onPick(id); o.close();
    }
    function makeRowView() {
      var row = LL.$new(act); row.setOrientation(0);
      row.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, ROW_H));
      var tiles = [];
      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) { var t = makeTile(); tiles.push(t); row.addView(t.cell); }
      return { row: row, tiles: tiles };
    }
    function fillRow(rowIdx, r) {
      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        var t = r.tiles[c], id = curIds[rowIdx * COLS + c];
        if (id === undefined) { t.id = -1; t.cell.setVisibility(GONE); continue; }
        t.id = id; t.cell.setVisibility(VIS);
        t.tv.setText(nameJava(id));
        var bm = null; try { bm = ICON.bitmap(id, ICON_PX); } catch (e) { err('取图标', e); }
        if (bm) { t.iv.setImageBitmap(bm); t.iv.setVisibility(VIS); t.ph.setVisibility(GONE); }
        else { t.iv.setVisibility(GONE); t.ph.setText(jStr('ID ' + id)); t.ph.setVisibility(VIS); }
      }
    }
    function applyWindow(first) {
      var total = Math.ceil(curIds.length / COLS);
      var maxFirst = Math.max(0, total - VIS_ROWS);
      if (first > maxFirst) first = maxFirst;
      if (first < 0) first = 0;
      for (var v = 0; v < rows.length; v++) {
        var want = (v < total) ? VIS : GONE;
        if (rows[v].vis !== want) { rows[v].vis = want; try { rows[v].row.setVisibility(want); } catch (e) {} }
      }
      var old = curFirst, d = (old < 0) ? 0 : (first - old);
      if (Math.abs(d) === 1) {
        if (d > 0) {
          var r0 = rows.shift(); rows.push(r0);
          try { win.removeView(r0.row); win.addView(r0.row); } catch (e) {}
          fillRow(first + VIS_ROWS - 1, r0);
        } else {
          var r1 = rows.pop(); rows.unshift(r1);
          try { win.removeView(r1.row); win.addView(r1.row, 0); } catch (e) {}
          fillRow(first, r1);
        }
      } else if (old < 0 || d !== 0) {
        for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) fillRow(first + i, rows[i]);
      }
      curFirst = first;
      try {
        topPad.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, first * ROW_H));
        botPad.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, Math.max(0, (total - first - VIS_ROWS) * ROW_H)));
      } catch (e) { err('占位高度', e); }
      try { ICON.prefetch(curIds.slice((first + VIS_ROWS) * COLS, (first + VIS_ROWS + 3) * COLS), ICON_PX); } catch (e) {}
    }
    function onScroll(y) {
      if (!rows.length || !topPad || !botPad || !curIds.length) return;
      var first = Math.floor(y / ROW_H);
      if (first === curFirst) return;
      applyWindow(first);
    }
    function ensureScroller() {
      if (SCROLLER) return;
      var I = juse('android.view.View$OnScrollChangeListener');
      SCROLLER = Java.registerClass({ name: uniq('Scr'), implements: [I],
        methods: { onScrollChange: function (v, x, y, ox, oy) {
          try { onScroll(y); } catch (e) { err('滚动', e); }
        } } }).$new();
      o.scroll.setOnScrollChangeListener(SCROLLER);
    }
    function hideIme() {
      try {
        var imm = act.getSystemService('input_method');
        if (imm && searchEt) imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(searchEt.getWindowToken(), 0);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    function showIme() {
      try {
        var imm = act.getSystemService('input_method');
        if (imm && searchEt) { searchEt.requestFocus(); imm.showSoftInput(searchEt, 0); }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    /* 重新算 id 列表 + 重建窗口（点分类 / 改搜索词都走这里） */
    function refreshList(reset) {
      curIds = computeIds();
      if (infoTv) infoTv.setText(jStr('共 ' + curIds.length + ' 件' + (curQuery ? ('（搜索：' + curQuery + '）') : '')));
      if (reset || !rows.length) {
        buildWindow();
        try { o.scroll.scrollTo(0, 0); } catch (e) {}
        applyWindow(0);
      } else {
        buildWindow();
        try { o.scroll.scrollTo(0, 0); } catch (e) {}
        applyWindow(0);
      }
      log('物品列表：分类=' + (curCat < 0 ? '全部' : CAT_NAMES[curCat]) + ' 搜索="' + curQuery + '" → ' +
          curIds.length + ' 件（' + Math.ceil(curIds.length / COLS) + ' 行）');
    }
    function buildWindow() {
      clear();
      topPad = juse('android.view.View').$new(act); topPad.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, 0));
      o.body.addView(topPad);
      win = LL.$new(act); win.setOrientation(1); win.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
      o.body.addView(win);
      botPad = juse('android.view.View').$new(act); botPad.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, 0));
      o.body.addView(botPad);
      rows = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < VIS_ROWS; i++) { var r = makeRowView(); rows.push(r); win.addView(r.row); }
      curFirst = -1;
    }
    function paintChips() {
      for (var k in chipBtns) {
        var on = (String(curCat) === k);
        try { chipBtns[k].setTextColor(on ? C.title : C.sub); } catch (e) {}
        try { chipBtns[k].setBackground(on ? K.flatOn(C.btn) : K.flat(C.btn)); } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
    function chip(label, cat) {
      var b = BT.$new(act); b.setText(jStr(label)); b.setTextSize(11); b.setTextColor(C.sub);
      K.compact(b); b.setBackground(K.flat(C.btn));
      b.setPadding(dp(8), dp(3), dp(8), dp(3));
      var lp = LLP.$new(WRAP, WRAP); lp.rightMargin.value = dp(3);
      b.setLayoutParams(lp);
      K.bindClick(b, function () { curCat = cat; paintChips(); refreshList(true); });
      chipBtns[String(cat)] = b;
      return b;
    }
    function buildChrome() {
      if (searchEt) return;
      /* ① 搜索行：EditText 用系统输入法 */
      var srow = LL.$new(act); srow.setOrientation(0); srow.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
      var ET = juse('android.widget.EditText');
      searchEt = ET.$new(act);
      searchEt.setHint(jStr('搜索物品名（用系统输入法）'));
      searchEt.setTextSize(12); searchEt.setSingleLine(true);
      try { searchEt.setInputType(1); } catch (e) {}                       // TYPE_CLASS_TEXT
      searchEt.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0));
      srow.addView(searchEt);
      var clr = BT.$new(act); clr.setText(jStr('清空')); clr.setTextSize(11); clr.setTextColor(C.sub);
      K.compact(clr); clr.setBackground(K.flat(C.btn));
      clr.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(WRAP, WRAP));
      K.bindClick(clr, function () {
        try { searchEt.setText(jStr('')); } catch (e) {}
        curQuery = ''; refreshList(true);
      });
      srow.addView(clr);
      o.root.addView(srow, 1);
      /* ② 分类：横向一排（可左右滑） */
      var HSV = juse('android.widget.HorizontalScrollView');
      var hs = HSV.$new(act);
      hs.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
      var bar = LL.$new(act); bar.setOrientation(0); bar.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(WRAP, WRAP));
      bar.addView(chip('全部', -1));
      for (var k = 0; k < CAT_NAMES.length; k++) {
        if (!idsOfCat(k).length) continue;
        bar.addView(chip(CAT_NAMES[k], k));
      }
      hs.addView(bar);
      chipRow = hs;
      o.root.addView(hs, 2);
      /* ③ 件数 */
      var irow = LL.$new(act); irow.setOrientation(0); irow.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
      infoTv = TV.$new(act); infoTv.setTextSize(11); infoTv.setTextColor(C.sub);
      infoTv.setPadding(dp(6), dp(2), dp(4), dp(2));
      infoTv.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0));
      irow.addView(infoTv);
      o.root.addView(irow, 3);
      /* ④ 搜索框的文字变化 → 过滤（TextWatcher 是单接口多方法，一个动态类搞定） */
      if (!WATCHER) {
        var TW = juse('android.text.TextWatcher');
        WATCHER = Java.registerClass({ name: uniq('TW'), implements: [TW], methods: {
          afterTextChanged: function (editable) {
            try {
              var q = editable ? String(editable.toString()) : '';
              if (q === curQuery) return;
              curQuery = q;
              refreshList(true);
            } catch (e) { err('搜索', e); }
          },
          beforeTextChanged: function (s, st, c, a) {},
          onTextChanged: function (s, st, b, c) {}
        } }).$new();
      }
      searchEt.addTextChangedListener(WATCHER);
      ensureScroller();
      paintChips();
      /* 搜索行 + 分类行 + 件数占了上面几条，列表高度按剩余空间收，别顶出屏幕 */
      try {
        var scrH = act.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels.value;
        var listH = Math.max(dp(140), Math.min(K.listPx, Math.round(scrH - K.posY() - dp(230))));
        o.scroll.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, listH));
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    globalThis.__pickShowList = function (cat) { curCat = (cat === undefined ? -1 : cat); if (searchEt) paintChips(); refreshList(true); };
    globalThis.__pickSearch = function (q) { curQuery = String(q || ''); try { searchEt.setText(jStr(curQuery)); } catch (e) {} refreshList(true); };
    globalThis.__pickScroll = function (row) { try { o.scroll.scrollTo(0, row * ROW_H); } catch (e) {} };
    globalThis.__pickTapAt = function (row, col) {
      try {
        var r = rows[row - curFirst];
        if (!r) { log('测试点击：窗口里没有第 ' + row + ' 行（当前从 ' + curFirst + ' 开始）'); return false; }
        var t = r.tiles[col || 0];
        log('测试点击：行 ' + row + ' 列 ' + (col || 0) + ' 物品 id=' + t.id);
        t.cell.performClick();
        return true;
      } catch (e) { log('测试点击失败 ' + e); return false; }
    };
    globalThis.__pickDump = function () {
      var out = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var one = [];
        for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
          var t = rows[i].tiles[c];
          if (t.cell.getVisibility() === GONE) { one.push('-'); continue; }
          one.push(t.id + (t.iv.getVisibility() === VIS ? '有图' : '无图'));
        }
        out.push('行' + (curFirst + i) + ': ' + one.join('  '));
      }
      log('窗口（first=' + curFirst + '，共 ' + Math.ceil(curIds.length / COLS) + ' 行）\n  ' + out.join('\n  '));
    };
    buildChrome();
    curCat = (startCat === undefined || startCat === null) ? -1 : startCat;
    paintChips();
    refreshList(true);
  }

  /* ═════════ 背包操作（读 / 增 / 删 / 改） ═════════
     布局：进页面自动刷新一次 → 分区网格（快捷栏 / 主背包 / 钱币 / 弹药 / 其它，不同底色区分）
           → 点任意格子在该格子**旁边弹出操作按钮**（放入·替换 / 改数量 / 复制 / 删除 / 清空背包）。
     性能：格子只建一次，之后按「type|stack|选中态」脏检查，只更新变了的格子。 */
  var BAG = { built: false, sel: -1, tiles: [], last: null, popup: null, t: 0 };

  var BAG_GROUPS = [
    { kind: 'hotbar', from: 0,  to: 9,  name: '快捷栏（1–0）' },
    { kind: 'main',   from: 10, to: 49, name: '主背包' },
    { kind: 'coin',   from: 50, to: 53, name: '钱币格（只能放钱币）' },
    { kind: 'ammo',   from: 54, to: 57, name: '弹药格（只能放弹药）' },
    { kind: 'other',  from: 58, to: 58, name: '其它' }
  ];
  function bagGroupOf(slot) {
    for (var i = 0; i < BAG_GROUPS.length; i++) {
      var g = BAG_GROUPS[i];
      if (slot >= g.from && slot <= g.to) return g;
    }
    return BAG_GROUPS[1];
  }
  function bagSlots() {
    try {
      var p = IL.player(); if (!p) return 0;
      var n = IL.invArr(p).add(0x18).readS32();
      return (n > 0 && n <= 60) ? n : 58;
    } catch (e) { return 58; }
  }
  function bagBg(kind, sel) {
    var K = S.ctx; if (!K) return null;
    if (sel) return K.flatOn(argb(0xFF, 0x33, 0x2A, 0x12));      // 选中：金边
    if (kind === 'hotbar') return K.flat(argb(0xFF, 0x16, 0x2A, 0x38));
    if (kind === 'coin')   return K.flat(argb(0xFF, 0x33, 0x2B, 0x12));
    if (kind === 'ammo')   return K.flat(argb(0xFF, 0x14, 0x2E, 0x22));
    if (kind === 'other')  return K.flat(argb(0xFF, 0x24, 0x1C, 0x2E));
    return K.flat(C.btn);
  }

  function bagBuild() {
    var K = S.ctx; if (!K || BAG.built) return;
    var juse = K.juse, act = K.act, dp = K.dp, WRAP = -2, MATCH = -1;
    var LL = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout'), TV = juse('android.widget.TextView'),
        IV = juse('android.widget.ImageView'), IVS = juse('android.widget.ImageView$ScaleType'),
        LLP = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout$LayoutParams'), GR = juse('android.view.Gravity');
    var host = S.groups['bag-grid'];
    if (!host) { log('背包：找不到 bag-grid 容器'); return; }
    /* 关键：先清空容器再建。任何原因导致 bagBuild 被调用第二次（重入/页面重复进入/守卫失效），
       否则会在下面再叠一整套标题+网格 —— 用户看到的就是「上面 4 块空白分区，下面 4 块有内容」。 */
    try { host.removeAllViews(); } catch (e) { err('清空背包容器', e); }
    BAG.builds = (BAG.builds || 0) + 1;
    if (BAG.builds > 1) log('背包：警告——建格被调用第 ' + BAG.builds + ' 次（已清空重建）');
    var N = bagSlots(), ICON_PX = dp(38);
    BAG.tiles = [];
    BAG_GROUPS.forEach(function (g) {
      var head = TV.$new(act);
      head.setText(jStr('▍' + g.name));
      head.setTextSize(10); head.setTextColor(C.sub);
      head.setPadding(dp(4), dp(4), dp(4), dp(2));
      host.addView(head);
      for (var s = g.from; s <= g.to; s += 4) {                  // 每行 4 格
        var row = LL.$new(act); row.setOrientation(0); row.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
        for (var c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
          var slot = s + c;
          /* 跨区了或超出真实槽位 → 放占位（保持 4 列对齐，但不建格子、不越界） */
          if (slot > g.to || slot >= N) {
            var sp = LL.$new(act); sp.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0)); row.addView(sp); continue;
          }
          var t = { slot: slot, kind: g.kind, group: g, cell: null };
          var cell = LL.$new(act); cell.setOrientation(1); cell.setGravity(GR.CENTER_HORIZONTAL.value);
          var lp = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0);
          lp.leftMargin.value = dp(2); lp.rightMargin.value = dp(2); lp.bottomMargin.value = dp(2);
          cell.setLayoutParams(lp); cell.setBackground(bagBg(g.kind, false));
          cell.setPadding(dp(1), dp(2), dp(1), dp(2));
          var iv = IV.$new(act); iv.setScaleType(IVS.FIT_CENTER.value);
          iv.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, ICON_PX));
          cell.addView(iv);
          var ph = TV.$new(act); ph.setTextSize(12); ph.setTextColor(C.sub);
          ph.setGravity(GR.CENTER.value); ph.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, ICON_PX));
          cell.addView(ph);
          var tv = TV.$new(act); tv.setTextSize(9); tv.setTextColor(C.text);
          tv.setGravity(GR.CENTER.value); tv.setMaxLines(1); tv.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
          cell.addView(tv);
          var nv = TV.$new(act); nv.setTextSize(8); nv.setTextColor(C.sub);
          nv.setGravity(GR.CENTER.value); nv.setMaxLines(1); nv.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
          cell.addView(nv);
          t.cell = cell; t.iv = iv; t.ph = ph; t.tv = tv; t.nv = nv;
          K.bindClick(cell, (function (tt) { return function () { bagTap(tt.slot); }; })(t));
          BAG.tiles.push(t);
          row.addView(cell);
        }
        host.addView(row);
      }
    });
    BAG.built = true;
    log('背包：已建 ' + BAG.tiles.length + ' 格（真实槽位 ' + N + '，分 ' + BAG_GROUPS.length + ' 区）');
  }

  function bagRead() {
    var out = [];
    try {
      var p = IL.player(); if (!p) return out;
      var arr = IL.invArr(p), N = bagSlots();
      for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        var it = IL.slotItem(arr, i);
        if (!it || it.isNull()) { out.push({ slot: i, type: 0, stack: 0, name: '' }); continue; }
        var ty = IL.getOn(IL.Item, it, 'type') | 0;
        var st = ty ? (IL.getOn(IL.Item, it, 'stack') | 0) : 0;
        var am = ty ? (IL.getOn(IL.Item, it, 'ammo') | 0) : 0;
        out.push({ slot: i, type: ty, stack: st, name: ty ? itemNameFast(ty) : '', ammo: am });
      }
    } catch (e) { err('读背包', e); }
    return out;
  }

  function bagRefresh(force) {
    if (!BAG.built) bagBuild();
    if (!BAG.tiles.length) return;
    var snap = bagRead(), changed = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < BAG.tiles.length; i++) {
      var t = BAG.tiles[i], d = snap[i];
      if (!d) continue;
      var sig = d.type + '|' + d.stack + '|' + (BAG.sel === i ? 1 : 0);
      if (!force && t.sig === sig) continue;
      t.sig = sig; changed++;
      if (d.type > 0) {
        var bm = null; try { bm = ICON.bitmap(d.type, dp2px(38)); } catch (e) {}
        if (bm) { t.iv.setImageBitmap(bm); t.iv.setVisibility(0); t.ph.setVisibility(8); }
        else { t.iv.setVisibility(8); t.ph.setText(jStr('?')); t.ph.setVisibility(0); }
        var nm = d.name || ('#' + d.type);
        t.tv.setText(jStr(nm.length > 5 ? nm.slice(0, 5) + '…' : nm));
        t.nv.setText(jStr('槽' + d.slot + (d.stack > 1 ? (' ×' + d.stack) : '')));
      } else {
        t.iv.setVisibility(8); t.ph.setText(jStr('+')); t.ph.setVisibility(0);
        t.tv.setText(jStr(t.group.kind === 'coin' ? '钱币' : t.group.kind === 'ammo' ? '弹药' : '空'));
        t.nv.setText(jStr('槽' + d.slot));
      }
      try { t.cell.setBackground(bagBg(t.kind, BAG.sel === i)); } catch (e) {}
    }
    BAG.last = snap;
    if (changed) log('背包：更新 ' + changed + ' 格（选中 ' + BAG.sel + '）');
    bagInfo();
  }
  function dp2px(v) { try { return Math.round(v * S.act.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density.value); } catch (e) { return v * 3; } }

  function bagInfo() {
    var d = BAG.last && BAG.last[BAG.sel], n = 0;
    if (BAG.last) for (var i = 0; i < BAG.last.length; i++) if (BAG.last[i].type > 0) n++;
    var txt = '背包共 ' + n + ' 件';
    if (BAG.sel < 0) txt += '　· 点格子弹出操作';
    else if (d && d.type > 0) txt += '　· 槽' + BAG.sel + '：' + (d.name || '#' + d.type) + ' ×' + d.stack + '（id ' + d.type + '）';
    else txt += '　· 槽' + BAG.sel + '（空）';
    UI.setLabel('bag-info', txt);
  }
  /* 只选中（放入物品后调用，不弹操作窗） */
  function bagSelect(slot) { BAG.sel = slot; bagRefresh(true); }
  /* 点格子：选中 + 在旁边弹操作按钮 */
  function bagTap(slot) { bagSelect(slot); bagPopup(slot); }
  function bagClosePopup() {
    var p = BAG.popup; BAG.popup = null;
    if (!p) return;
    try {
      var par = S.parent;
      if (par) par.removeView(p.root); else { var g = p.root.getParent(); if (g) g.removeView(p.root); }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  function bagPopup(slot) {
    var K = S.ctx; if (!K) return;
    bagClosePopup();
    var juse = K.juse, act = K.act, dp = K.dp, WRAP = -2, MATCH = -1;
    var FL = juse('android.widget.FrameLayout'), LL = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout'),
        BT = juse('android.widget.Button'), TV = juse('android.widget.TextView'),
        FLP = juse('android.widget.FrameLayout$LayoutParams'), LLP = juse('android.widget.LinearLayout$LayoutParams'),
        V = juse('android.view.View'), GD = juse('android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable');
    var root = FL.$new(act);
    var dim = V.$new(act);                       // 全屏透明层：点空白处关掉
    dim.setLayoutParams(FLP.$new(MATCH, MATCH));
    root.addView(dim);
    var box = LL.$new(act); box.setOrientation(1);
    var bg = GD.$new(); bg.setColor(argb(0xF5, 0x12, 0x18, 0x20));
    bg.setCornerRadius(dp(10)); bg.setStroke(dp(1), C.title);
    box.setBackground(bg); box.setPadding(dp(6), dp(6), dp(6), dp(6));
    var d = BAG.last && BAG.last[slot];
    var title = TV.$new(act);
    title.setText(jStr('槽' + slot + '　' + (d && d.type > 0 ? ((d.name || ('#' + d.type)).slice(0, 8) + ' ×' + d.stack) : bagGroupOf(slot).name)));
    title.setTextSize(11); title.setTextColor(C.title);
    title.setPadding(dp(2), 0, dp(2), dp(4));
    box.addView(title);
    /* 两列紧凑排布：竖排 7 个按钮要 780px（占屏 72%），根本贴不到格子旁边 */
    function addRow(pairs) {
      var row = LL.$new(act); row.setOrientation(0); row.setLayoutParams(LLP.$new(MATCH, WRAP));
      for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
        var label = pairs[i][0], actionId = pairs[i][1], danger = pairs[i][2];
        var b = BT.$new(act); b.setText(jStr(label)); b.setTextSize(10);
        b.setTextColor(danger ? C.warn : C.text);
        K.compact(b); b.setBackground(K.flat(C.btn));
        b.setPadding(dp(2), dp(4), dp(2), dp(4));
        var lp = LLP.$new(0, WRAP, 1.0);
        if (i) lp.leftMargin.value = dp(3);
        lp.bottomMargin.value = dp(3);
        b.setLayoutParams(lp);
        K.bindClick(b, function () { bagClosePopup(); try { S.dispatch(actionId); } catch (e) { err('背包操作 ' + actionId, e); } });
        row.addView(b);
      }
      box.addView(row);
    }
    var isCoin = (bagGroupOf(slot).kind === 'coin'), isAmmo = (bagGroupOf(slot).kind === 'ammo');
    var putLabel = isCoin ? '放入钱币' : isAmmo ? '放入弹药' : '放入/替换';
    if (d && d.type > 0) {
      addRow([[putLabel, 'bag-replace'], ['改数量', 'bag-count']]);
      addRow([['复制到空格', 'bag-copy'], ['删除该格', 'bag-del', true]]);
    } else {
      addRow([[putLabel, 'bag-replace'], ['关闭', '__bag-close']]);
    }
    addRow([['⚠清空背包', 'bag-clear', true], ['关闭', '__bag-close']]);
    /* 弹在格子旁边：用格子的屏幕坐标 */
    var loc = Java.array('int', [0, 0]);
    try { BAG.tiles[slot].cell.getLocationOnScreen(loc); } catch (e) {}
    var sw = 0, sh = 0;
    try {
      var dm = act.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
      sw = dm.widthPixels.value; sh = dm.heightPixels.value;
    } catch (e) {}
    /* 贴着格子：默认放格子下方，下面放不下就翻到上方（之前固定预留 260dp 会把所有弹窗都夹到同一位置） */
    var boxW = dp(168);
    var boxH = (box.getChildCount() * dp(32)) + dp(18);        // 按行数估算（每行约 32dp）
    var x = Math.max(dp(4), Math.min(loc[0] + dp(50), sw - boxW - dp(4)));
    var y = loc[1] + dp(58);
    if (y + boxH > sh - dp(8)) y = Math.max(dp(4), loc[1] - boxH - dp(8));
    y = Math.max(dp(4), Math.min(y, Math.max(dp(4), sh - boxH - dp(4))));
    var lp2 = FLP.$new(boxW, WRAP);
    lp2.leftMargin.value = Math.round(x); lp2.topMargin.value = Math.round(y);
    root.addView(box, lp2);
    K.bindClick(dim, function () { bagClosePopup(); });
    try { act.addContentView(root, FLP.$new(MATCH, MATCH)); } catch (e) { err('背包弹窗', e); }
    BAG.popup = { root: root, close: bagClosePopup };
    log('背包：槽' + slot + ' 操作弹窗（格子@' + loc[0] + ',' + loc[1] + ' → 弹窗@' + Math.round(x) + ',' + Math.round(y) + '）');
  }
  function bagSlot() { return BAG.sel; }
  function bagItem() {
    var d = BAG.last && BAG.last[BAG.sel];
    return (d && d.type > 0) ? d : null;
  }

  function mount(spec, dispatch, onReady) {
    if (typeof Java === 'undefined' || !Java.available) { log('Frida Java 桥不可用，无法建立系统菜单'); return; }
    Java.perform(function () {
      try {
        var act = findActivity();
        if (!act) { log('找不到 Activity（游戏没在前台？），菜单未挂载'); return; }
        onMain(function () { build(act, spec, dispatch); onMain(function () { if (onReady) onReady(); }); });
      } catch (e) { err('查找 Activity', e); }
    });
  }

  /* 收起/展开（标题栏 ▾ 按钮用）；收起态记在 S.collapsed */
  /* 顶部标签页切换（build 里实现，这里包一层供外部/自检调用） */
  function showPage(id) { try { if (S.showPage) S.showPage(id); else log('面板未挂载，无法切页'); } catch (e) { err('切标签页', e); } }

  function toggleCollapse() {
